hypothesis: Replacing E004's joint physical u/v relative MSE with an equal mix of per-channel physical relative MSE and official-geometry wake-probe relative MSE, holding every other E004 control fixed, will raise validation Rel-L2 or MVPE by at least 0.30 versus E004, keep the other within 0.25 of E004, keep TKE at least 70.247, and keep Time at least 86 when scored with the frozen E006 interval.
comparator: E004/E007 no-adaptation packed FNO on real_regime_v1 validation via local_bench_v1

decision_criterion.accept_rule: max(Rel-L2 gain, MVPE gain) >= 0.30 and min(Rel-L2 gain, MVPE gain) >= -0.25 and TKE >= 70.247 and Time >= 86

data.normalization: official mean_std_real.pt; evaluator-aligned, not recomputed on the train split

loss.name: channel_mvpe_physical_relative_mse
loss.formula: 0.5 * mean_{n,c<2}(sum_{t,h,w}(pred_c-tgt_c)^2 / max(sum_{t,h,w} tgt_c^2, eps)) + 0.5 * mean_{n,stations}( ||time_mean(pred_probes)-time_mean(tgt_probes)||^2 / max(||time_mean(tgt_probes)||^2, eps) )
loss.mvpe_geometry: official scoring.py: d=16, center_x=10, center_y=32, n_probe=9, sub_s_real=2 -> y=[8,10,...,24], x=[13,21,29,37]

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update; no validation-based early stopping
training.budget_note: Isolated change versus E004: joint u/v physical relative MSE -> 0.5 channel-balanced + 0.5 official MVPE-probe relative MSE. Same 600 updates, split, init, seed, optimizer. Do not change mix weights after training starts.
